_readme: An example of the format. Your own sites go in ~/.claude/audit-seo-geo/sites.json, which updates keep: when the requested URL is there, the skill skips the first round of questions (references/intake.md). priorites: the order of the to-do groups (optional).

atelier-lumen.example.activite: quoting and scheduling software for UK tradespeople (fictional site)
atelier-lumen.example.valeur: a quote written in two minutes on a phone and signed on site, before the tradesperson leaves
atelier-lumen.example.qui_corrige: a web agency, in the site's code
